explainer_content.short_definition: Adult R&B for the late-night room: smooth, romantic, controlled, and deeply vocal.
explainer_content.history_capsule: Quiet storm emerged from soul and R&B radio traditions that favored mood, intimacy, and adult romance over funk intensity or disco release.
explainer_content.why_it_mattered: It created a durable adult R&B language that shaped radio, slow jams, and later smooth soul production.
explainer_content.what_made_it_distinct: Everything is softened and focused: tempo, texture, vocal phrasing, and emotional temperature.
